bait_content.title: Keyring Unlock Required
bait_content.body: Chrome tried to access the system secrets service (org.freedesktop.secrets) for saved passwords and sync tokens, but the 'Login' keyring is locked. Unlock to restore autofill, extensions, and account sync for this session.
